summary: Pre-market, the composite risk score prints 47.49 — still the caution band inside a goldilocks regime, but 5.67 higher in a day, and the whole weekly move happened in this one session. The rise is composition-driven rather than stress-driven: cross-asset confirmation is the largest single contributor, the 10Y held at 4.63 while the 2Y slipped to 4.18, the 10Y real rate edged up to 2.41, and high-yield spreads widened only marginally to 2.75. Overnight the memory theme split along geography — Chinese memory and advanced-packaging names closed sharply higher, led by GigaDevice at 8.32, while the US complex traded heavy after Sandisk and Western Digital earnings, with Micron down 1.31. Two mechanical caveats belong on the front page: the volatility dimension carries zero coverage this run, so its weight of 15.0 is redistributed across the other five dimensions, and the equities, news and risk datasets are all flagged degraded. The immediate catalyst is the US Employment Situation at 12:30 UTC, about an hour after this brief.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation at 0.6667 is the single largest contributor to the composite, adding 8.82 — the risk is that assets are moving together rather than hedging one another.
The rates block supplies the next two contributors: the 10Y real rate at 2.41 adds 5.80 and the 10Y nominal at 4.63 adds 5.46, keeping macro the highest-scoring dimension at 64.3.
The reverse repo balance has drained to 1.429 and contributes 4.03 — the buffer that has absorbed liquidity shocks is close to exhausted, so any further drain has to come out of reserves at 2993349.
Leadership is thin: only 0.0467 of the universe is at new highs and 0.6667 sits above its MA200, while small caps trail at -0.7404 and semis lead at 0.3278.
Labour quality is eroding underneath a falling headline: unemployment at 4.2 improved while participation fell to 61.5 and continuing claims rose to 1801000.

supporting_signals.claim: Credit deterioration is confined to the low-quality tail: high yield widened to 2.75 while investment grade was unchanged at 0.78.
Inflation expectations firmed rather than eased, with the 10Y breakeven at 2.26 and the 5Y5Y forward at 2.29 — that keeps upward pressure on the real-rate path.
The dollar is firm on both gauges, with the broad index at 119.7034 and the advanced-economies index at 112.8987 — a tightening cross-current for risk assets.
US semis did not confirm the Asian memory rally: Micron fell 1.3122 and Nvidia slipped 0.1049 on the session.

contradicting_signals.claim: The score of 47.49 rose with no volatility input at all — that dimension carries coverage of 0.00 and effective weight of 0.0 this run, so the increase is a weighting artefact as much as a signal.
Trend is intact: three-month momentum at 4.7327, price 9.4097 above its MA200, and a 52-week drawdown of only -0.3591.
The official disinflation series still cooperate: headline CPI at 3.46353, core CPI at 2.56579 and core PCE at 3.28653 all printed below their prior readings.
Funding is not yet stressed despite the reverse repo drawdown, with SOFR easing to 3.64 against a Fed balance sheet of 6748567.

what_changed_today: The composite rose 5.67 in a day to 47.49; the weekly change is also 5.67, so the entire week's move landed in this session.
VIX fell from 16.5 to 15.81 even as the risk score rose — the vol market did not corroborate the move.
The 2Y slipped from 4.2 to 4.18 while the 10Y held at 4.63, steepening the curve to a slope of 0.45.
High yield widened from 2.73 to 2.75 while investment grade held at 0.78.
Reverse repo drained from 1.65 to 1.429 while reserve balances rose from 2984570 to 2993349.
Breakevens firmed, the 10Y from 2.22 to 2.26 and the 5Y5Y forward from 2.26 to 2.29.
A-share memory and packaging names closed sharply higher — GigaDevice 8.3247, Longsys 5.5333, BIWIN 5.1258, Ingenic 5.146 and TFME 6.168 — against Micron at -1.3122 in the US.
watch_next: The US Employment Situation at 12:30 UTC is the immediate catalyst; the prior payrolls print slowed to 57.0 from 129.0 and participation fell to 61.5, so an unemployment rate that falls for the wrong reason would read hawkish.
Next week brings CPI, PPI and advance retail sales, all flagged high importance — the disinflation narrative is re-tested three times in one week.
Whether the memory divergence resolves: fresh capacity commitments from SK Hynix against Micron at -1.3122 set up a supply-response debate that decides whether the Asian rally is a lead or a trap.
Whether the reverse repo drawdown to 1.429 starts to bite — if reserves stop rising with the buffer exhausted, funding pressure shows up in SOFR at 3.64 first.
Whether the volatility dimension regains coverage; until it does, treat the 47.49 level as understating volatility risk rather than as a clean reading.

bull_case.title: Bull case: disinflation holds and trend keeps its bid
points: Core PCE at 3.28653 and core CPI at 2.56579 both undershot their prior prints; an Employment Situation that softens through demand normalisation rather than layoffs keeps the easing path open.
The trend engine is undamaged, with momentum at 4.7327 and price 9.4097 above its MA200 on a 52-week drawdown of just -0.3591.
Credit refuses to confirm the equity narrowing: investment grade is unchanged at 0.78 and high yield at 2.75 is still historically tight.

base_case.title: Base case: a rates-and-breadth problem, not a credit event
points: The composite holds the caution band near 47.49 with the goldilocks regime intact while the real rate sits at 2.41.
Leadership stays narrow, with semis at 0.3278 relative strength against small caps at -0.7404 and new highs at 0.0467.
The Employment Situation lands close enough to expectations that the curve keeps its 0.45 slope, leaving the 12:30 UTC print a volatility event rather than a regime break.

bear_case.title: Bear case: rates and liquidity squeeze a narrow tape
points: If the real rate pushes above 2.41 while breakevens hold near 2.26, the discount-rate pressure lands hardest on the most extended leadership.
With reverse repo at 1.429 the shock absorber is gone, so any drain on reserves from 2993349 transmits straight into funding markets.
Breadth of 0.6667 above the MA200 with only 0.0467 at new highs means an index-level break would have very little underneath it.
